results.description:
This is the year you change your life.

There's a saying that when the moment comes, you don't need words on a page, you need new thoughts in your head. When the moment really comes when you have to find your courage, when you have to let go, when you don't know what to do, you aren't going to go to your bookshelf to find the answer. You need it with you here and now.

Devote the next twelve months of your life to making measured and real change, beginning with your mindset.

The Pivot Year is a book of 365 daily meditations on finding the courage to become who you've always wanted to be, from the internationally best selling author of "101 Essays That Will Change The Way You Think," "The Mountain Is You," and more.
